$comment: nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] where cause is imported-by effect. ADD invariants by hand.

invariants.modular_monolith_dependency_direction: core/ depends on nothing; outer modules (agents, api, orchestrator, memory, integrations) depend inward only, never on each other directly except through core/workflow_engine.py or models/. observability is cross-cutting middleware, not a dependency of domain logic. (ADR-002)
invariants.outbound_calls_have_timeouts: every LLM call, GitHub API call, and Tiger/Postgres query goes through reliability/timeout.py + reliability/retry.py + reliability/circuit_breaker.py — no raw httpx/asyncpg/openai client call without a bound timeout.
invariants.untrusted_diff_content_never_executed: PR diff/code content is data, not instructions — it is only ever passed to LLMs as a clearly-delimited untrusted context block (security/injection_guard.py) and is never eval'd, shelled out, or used to construct SQL/paths without parameterization/sanitization.
